requested_use: Internal company use for final production gearbox design and load ratings
distribution_constraint: Application, tests and bundled reference data must be publishable on GitHub; no proprietary standards or private reference package required

engineering_tests.note: Includes a rerun after final editor layout refinement

open_geometry_comparison.scope: External gear reference/base/tip/root diameters, pressure angles and operating center distance only

native_packages.status: Final rc4 Windows build in progress; rc3 native results are historical

scope_limits: 72 independent scalar comparisons cover specified geometry quantities only.
Force, energy and revolution checks are analytical verification, not measured gearbox validation.
Efficiency remains assumed; exposure counts are not fatigue damage or service-life ratings.
Material, heat treatment, lubricant and supplier declarations are not verified allowables.
No ISO/AGMA compliance claim; no proprietary standard tables, text or illustrations bundled.
Fatigue/contact, shaft/bearing/assembly, thermal/manufacturing and physical qualification remain outstanding.
Native distribution is unsigned; interactive acceptance on company workstation images remains outstanding.
